description: The workspace's giveaways, newest first, with entry counts and what each needs next (draw, or announce).

limit.description: How many to return, e.g. 20; the tool's own maximum applies

offset.description: How many to skip, e.g. 20 for the second page of 20

post_id.description: Only giveaways on this post (a UUID): from post_list

state.description: Only giveaways in this state, e.g. draft, open or drawn

workspace.description: Workspace ID. Optional when the connection has a default or only one workspace.

name: giveaway_list
title: Giveaways
